items.quote: Succeeding as a new real estate agent in a market depends 70% on the belief system you have and the environment you are in.
items.statement: Succeeding as a new real estate agent in a market depends 70% on the belief system you have and the environment you are in.

items.quote: Your first sales team can determine whether or not you will make money in your first year.
items.statement: Your first sales team can determine whether or not you will make money in your first year.

items.quote: The wrong way to make decisions on which company to join is based solely on the commission split.
items.statement: The wrong way to decide which company to join is based solely on the commission split.

items.quote: My key point is that you should establish whether or not you can be productive in a company as a new agent.
items.statement: You should establish whether or not you can be productive in a company as a new agent.

items.quote: 1) What are the character traits of the people who succeed in your team?
items.statement: Ask about the character traits of the people who succeed in your team.

items.quote: 2) What is the company's business model, and where do the leads come from?
items.statement: What is the company's business model, and where do the leads come from?

items.quote: 3) How do you plan to help me develop my skills?
items.statement: How do you plan to help me develop my skills?

items.quote: What is my potential career path in this company? Is there an opportunity for growth, and what does that look like?
items.statement: Is there an opportunity for growth, and what does that look like?

items.quote: My first team in Dubai was led by Guy Last . He taught us the foundational pieces, such as prospecting, cold calling, closing techniques, team support, and accountability.
items.statement: My first team in Dubai was led by Guy Last, who taught foundational pieces that determined my success.

overview: LinkedIn post discussing factors for new real estate agents' success.
